paragraphs.text: House Bikov was one of the five powerful houses in Arathoxia , ruled by Marshall Bikov . Its seat was Arathoxia's docks, and its domain included the Western Isles, presumably including Lighthouse Island .

House Bikov was also known as House Sapphire , after the blue Mox that ended up in the possession of Liana of Minorad , and much later, the battlemage Ravidel . Before this happened, though, House Bikov was destroyed in Ravidel’s invasion of Arathoxia, obliterated along with its leader by Ravidel's Chaos Orb .

Marshall Bikov was the merfolk lord of House Bikov in Arathoxia on Corondor , and the lord of the docks of Arathoxia and the Western Isles. He was allied with Lady Verdenth during Ravidel ’s invasion of Arathoxia, but was killed by the Chaos Orb .
